cards.name: Uba Mask
cards.oracleText:
If a player would draw a card, that player exiles that card face up instead.
Each player may play lands and cast spells from among cards they exiled with this artifact this turn.

cards.name: Ubul Sar Gatekeepers
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you control two or more Gates, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
